name: TRANSIT INTELLIGENCE - High Impact Alerts v1

parameters.query: SELECT o.id::text AS transit_observation_id, o.external_key, o.title, o.description, o.status, o.mode, o.route_key, o.route_name, o.asset_key, o.asset_name, o.municipality, o.county, o.state, o.source_url, o.impact_score, o.starts_at, o.ends_at, o.latitude, o.longitude, o.alert_emitted_at, o.last_changed_at, p.provider_key, p.name AS provider_name FROM transit_observations o JOIN transit_providers p ON p.id=o.provider_id WHERE o.active=true AND o.alert_pending=true AND o.impact_level='ALERT' ORDER BY o.impact_score DESC,o.last_changed_at DESC LIMIT 50;

WITH d AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j), upserted AS ( INSERT INTO alerts (schema_version, alert_id, source, source_event_id, category, subtype, status, event_action, title, message, priority, county, municipality, location, tags, click_url, source_url, observed_at, source_updated_at, received_at, expires_at, metadata, raw_payload, search_text, updated_at) SELECT COALESCE(j->>'schema_version','1.0'), j->>'alert_id', j->>'source', NULLIF(j->>'source_event_id',''), j->>'category', j->>'subtype', j->>'status', j->>'event_action', j->>'title', j->>'message', (j->>'priority')::integer, NULLIF(j->>'county',''), NULLIF(j->>'municipality',''), COALESCE(j->'location','{}'::jsonb), ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(j->'tags','[]'::jsonb))), NULLIF(j->>'click_url',''), NULLIF(j->>'source_url',''), NULLIF(j->>'observed_at','')::timestamptz, NULLIF(j->>'source_updated_at','')::timestamptz, COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'received_at','')::timestamptz,NOW()), NULLIF(j->>'expires_at','')::timestamptz, COALESCE(j->'metadata','{}'::jsonb), j, NULLIF(j->>'search_text',''), NOW() FROM d ON CONFLICT (alert_id) DO UPDATE SET status=EXCLUDED.status, event_action=EXCLUDED.event_action, title=EXCLUDED.title, message=EXCLUDED.message, priority=EXCLUDED.priority, county=EXCLUDED.county, municipality=EXCLUDED.municipality, location=EXCLUDED.location, tags=EXCLUDED.tags, click_url=EXCLUDED.click_url, source_url=EXCLUDED.source_url, observed_at=EXCLUDED.observed_at, source_updated_at=EXCLUDED.source_updated_at, expires_at=EXCLUDED.expires_at, metadata=EXCLUDED.metadata, raw_payload=EXCLUDED.raw_payload, search_text=EXCLUDED.search_text, updated_at=NOW() RETURNING id::text AS alert_db_uuid ) SELECT d.j AS alert, upserted.alert_db_uuid FROM d CROSS JOIN upserted;

nodes.name: Send Transit to Central Watchlist Matcher

parameters.query: UPDATE transit_observations SET alert_pending=false, alert_emitted_at=now(), updated_at=now() WHERE id = NULLIF($1::jsonb->'alert'->'metadata'->>'transit_observation_id','')::uuid RETURNING id::text AS transit_observation_id, alert_emitted_at;
